description: Rare opportunity to own a renovated 4 bed 2 bath home in the vibrant community of Woodland Hills. For sale after 49 years. Offering approx. 1,566 SF of living space on a spacious 8,758 SF lot, this property features an attached two-car garage and a thoughtfully designed open floor plan with pitched ceilings and abundant natural light throughout. The bright living room showcases a cozy fireplace, while the island kitchen offers ample cabinetry, pantry storage, recessed lighting, and French door access to the exterior. Additional features include central air conditioning, a tankless water heater, hallway storage, and bedrooms filled with natural light. Two bedrooms feature a Jack-and-Jill bathroom with shower, and dual French doors leading to the backyard from one of bedrooms. Bedroom 3 also includes a walk-in closet and French doors with backyard access, while Bedroom 4 offers direct side yard access through a French door and window. Upgraded hallway bathroom includes a shower-over-tub combination. A spacious family room with high ceilings and skylights creates the perfect setting for gatherings and entertaining, complete with dual French doors opening to the outdoors. The attached garage is bright and functional with high pitched ceilings, skylights, built-in cabinetry, and ample storage for tools and accessories. The expansive backyard is ideal for relaxation and entertaining, featuring a covered patio, koi pond, a Hen house, additional animal enclosure perfect for hobbyists. Ample storage rooms, shed, and an additional room perfect for a home office or kids playroom. Spacious backyard offers endless possibilities for customization and outdoor enjoyment. Minutes from Pierce College, Calvert Charter Elementary School, I-101 FWY, shopping, and dining options. Sold AS IS and WHERE IS, with all faults, and without warranty, express or implied. Seller will not be responsible for any repairs, inspection reports, termite work, or mandatory government retrofit requirements prior to closing. Property profile and Zimas shows the property with 3 bath. The additional rooms on the south side of the house appear to be permitted, while the permit status of the room at the rear of the property could not be determined. Neither Seller nor Broker/Agents guarantee the accuracy of the square footage, lot size, permits or other information concerning the conditions or features of the Property. Buyer is advised to independently verify the accuracy of all information through personal inspections and with the appropriate professionals.
